name: deepseek-harness
description: Attach to an authorized Desktop Host with per-caller native Codex sandbox filesystem tools.

interface.shortDescription: Delegate with per-caller native filesystem policy.
interface.longDescription: Use an explicitly authorized existing Desktop Host and a local execution bridge. Inherit the calling Codex policy unchanged for adapted file tools; reject all unsupported tools and policies.
interface.defaultPrompt: Check doctor, connect only with my approved file, and inspect_access_scope for this agent’s requested read/write directories. Use host-supplied policy and launcher metadata. Dispatch only when native preflight succeeds and model work is authorized; show dsh://open and sessionId.
